scope: Personal Wi-Fi SecretAgent recovery for existing system-owned or not-saved NetworkManager profiles. No enterprise provisioning, agent-owned vault, WPS or physical-hardware claim.

architecture.domain: NetworkCredentialRequestId and nonsecret NetworkCredentialRequest; NetworkPort.watch_credentials and consuming answer_credentials. Existing NetworkSnapshot stays unchanged.
architecture.adapter: Explicit NetworkManager.with_secret_agent enables one SecretAgent on the existing unique-owner-pinned system-bus connection. Bounded one-shot callbacks validate exact native profile path/current handle/UUID/rawSSID/security/flags/hints and retire on cancellation/removal/service/observer loss.
architecture.client: Generation-bound zeroizing form uses existing masked_input and semantic recipes. Credential answers use the existing controls lane independently of ordinary activation. No OS IO in views; no new framework policy.
architecture.persistence: Return credentials to the original GetSecrets call; never AddAndActivate for repair. NetworkManager retains secret-storage authority; no vault or profile-storage override is claimed.

prior_focused_checks.filter_scope: Filter was network and includes unrelated tests whose names contain network; these are not claimed as 29 dedicated network tests.
new_protocol_cases_passed: Activation deliberately holds its native reply beyond the normal five-second deadline; independent credential answer completes it with one original profile and no Join.
Untrusted sender, unsupported/noninteractive flags, hints, enterprise security, agent-owned vault and UUID mismatch rejected.
Native cancellation, profile retirement, daemon-owner loss and stale one-shot reply authority rejected.
prior_focused_checks.final_source_delta: Later commit adds terminal-activation UI cleanup, a client lifecycle test, a pure layout/focus/redaction test, and two visual fixtures; those changes are not covered by this earlier test result.

strict_checks.source_equivalence: Only the eight newly reviewed credential PNG baselines differ; all executable, token, Python and site sources are byte-identical to the executed strict cohort.

visual_checks.backend: Physical AMD Vulkan offscreen; pixel/layout evidence, not frame pacing or scanout.

native_checks.scope: Regular-user native panel with real pointer/keyboard, NetworkManager and owned simulated WPA2/hidden radios. No physical Wi-Fi, SAE/OWE/enterprise, captive-portal or suspend proof.

discovered_and_fixed: A reconstructed randomized map changed aligned wire body length between zbus sizing and serialization, reproducibly declaring 121 bytes while writing 122. A deterministic serializer and 896 wire-contract samples cover the fix.
Old observer cleanup could clear a replacement observer pending request; retirement now detaches authority atomically before reopening admission, with callback wakeups outside the lock.
Profile metadata changes could leave a callback live while Activate held the snapshot loop; exact-profile update notices now immediately retire it.
remaining: Physical Wi-Fi/driver, SAE/OWE, enterprise/WEP provisioning, WPS and agent-owned secret-vault support.
Captive-portal UX, suspend/hotplug and broad third-party interoperability acceptance.
No new RSS, animation smoothness, GPU execution or scanout measurement.
The other goal-wide display, text, dock/tray, screenshot/history and integration gaps remain separate work.
